question: By what fourfold means should the place of the seat be consecrated?
premises: The seat-place is to be consecrated.
The means begin with glancing and include similar acts.
inference: One should consecrate the place of the seat by means of the four acts beginning with glancing.
uncertainties: The other three acts besides glancing are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should consecrate the place of the seat with the four acts beginning with glancing.
